Administration

Team Access

Gary Visa staff management. Add verified accounts and choose each member’s Operations and CMS access. Changes apply to Gary Visa only.

Add an existing account

The person must already have a verified sign-in. No account or password is created or changed.

Only an Operations Admin can assign Operations roles.
Only a CMS Admin can assign CMS roles.

Staff directory

You can change roles below Admin in your own area. Your account and Admins are view only.

Role permissions

Operations and CMS access are independent. Operations Admins manage Staff and Manager; CMS Admins manage Editor and Publisher. Admin roles are changed by the owner.

Operations

Staff
Assigned cases, contacts and chats, with their documents and notes.
Manager
Staff access plus every case and all assignments.
Operations Admin
Full operations, including case and contact trash and restore.

CMS

Editor
Create and edit content.
Publisher
Editor access plus publishing and archiving.
CMS Admin
Publisher access plus content trash and restore.

Protections

  • Nobody can change their own roles.
  • Admin roles are never granted, changed or removed here, including another Admin’s. The owner manages them.
  • Operations Admins can’t assign CMS roles, and CMS Admins can’t assign Operations roles.
  • Unconfirmed, suspended or removed accounts get no access, whatever their roles.
  • No Access keeps the account, assignments and history. Passwords and other Gary platforms are managed elsewhere.
  • Every addition and role change is recorded with who made it and when.
